inputs.name: searchLoops.input
inputs.description: Optional object: root is the project directory whose specification/loop-templates and specification/loops are read, defaulting to process.cwd() when omitted; query is trimmed and matched case-insensitively as a substring of each row's kind, id, title, summary and source, and an absent, empty or whitespace-only query returns every row. Only root and query are read, so the inherited now callback has no effect.

inputs.name: renderLoopSearchResults.results
inputs.description: Rows to render, in the order supplied; the text shows each row's kind, id, title and summary and omits source, and an empty array produces the no-match message.

examples.title: Feature Delivery
examples.summary: Spec, implement, test, and verify a user-facing or API feature.

examples.title: Add password reset to the login flow

outputs.name: searchLoops
outputs.description: Resolves to template rows (built-in templates first, then project templates from specification/loop-templates) followed by loop rows sorted by directory name, filtered by the query when it is not blank. A loop directory without loop.json is omitted; a loop.json that is malformed, fails the loop schema or cannot be read becomes a diagnostic row whose id is the directory name, and a readable loop's id is its stored name.

examples.summary: Persisted loop JSON is malformed; stored steps are unavailable.

outputs.name: renderLoopSearchResults
outputs.description: Plain text with one block per row in input order: a `kind: id` line, then the title and summary lines indented by two spaces, with blocks separated by a blank line. An empty array returns exactly 'No loop templates or loop instances matched.'
examples:
template: feature
  Feature Delivery
  Spec, implement, test, and verify a user-facing or API feature.

loop: password-reset
  Add password reset to the login flow
  2 of 4 steps complete.
No loop templates or loop instances matched.

errors.name: Loop search filesystem failure
errors.description: A read error on specification/loops other than a missing directory is rethrown, and a template discovery error (an unreadable specification/loop-templates directory or file, malformed template JSON, or an invalid template field) passes through; either one rejects searchLoops. Unreadable or malformed persisted loop files never reject searchLoops and become diagnostic rows instead.
